application_rule: Start with base and verify SHA. Apply v2-v4 replacement_operations with expected prior tier/decision and append additions. Then apply v5 priority_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id with expected_current_tier+decision preconditions; require 132 unique coverage. Sort by forecast_investigation_rank. Never infer approval or auto-download. Then apply v6 efficiency_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id and assert matching v5 wave/rank/decision for all 132. Resource screening never implies runtime success or download approval. Then apply v7 parameter_gate_operations to all 109 models; verify each expected prior status and total params from source. For >=250B apply explicit exclusion replacement_operations; for null total params block final lock. Keep datasets exempt. Assert 132 unique assets and 109 param checks. Do not download. Then apply v8 total-model-parameter gate on each of 109 models, validating expected v7 decision/tier/gate. Apply one explicit new HOLD-to-EXCLUDED transition; keep previous EXCLUDED. Block final lock if unknown. Reject >=150B. Datasets exempt. Then apply v9 parameter_evidence_operations to exactly 25 prior-UNVERIFIED models, asserting per-record expected tier/decision/status, promoting only first-party documented complete published model or major inference component counts; leave 12 unknown and enforce 150B cap, independent dependency/manifest rights. Then apply v10 conditional/R1 -> hold/HOLD transition for dphn/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.1-8B with exact expected prior state. Reject blocked and excluded models from v10 candidate list.
